title: Critical spectral behavior and large deviations for geometric $α$-stable processes
summary: In this paper, we study the Schrödinger-type operator associated with geometric stable processes on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$, especially the differentiability of spectral function. Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the generator of the geometric stable process and $μ$ a smooth measure on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$. Then the spectral function $C(θ)$ is defined as $C(θ) = -\inf σ(-\mathcal{H} - θμ)$, where $σ(\mathcal{A})$ denotes the spectrum of $\mathcal{A}$ and $θ$ is a real parameter.
